method: Eleventh lunch pass. Cupertino first, then the 10-15 mile ring; this file is the Milpitas sweep. Every field below was transcribed from a page actually retrieved this turn (URL in the row). Nothing was typed from memory. Yelp business pages return HTTP 403 to direct fetch in this environment, so Yelp facts are recorded from the Yelp business-page URL as surfaced by search and levelled 'listing'/'conflicting', never 'official'. Rows whose name is shared by an out-of-area twin are flagged rather than silently merged.

entries.name: Wagyu Grill AYCE (牛浪人 Wagyu Grill)

lunch_special.name: Lunch AYCE tier - $25.95 per person
lunch_special.includes: Select wagyu cuts, sushi rolls, appetizers and sides. The all-day tiers are higher: Silver $35.95, Gold $43.95, Premium $65.95 (Japanese A5).

fits_return_bus.note: Milpitas is ~10 mi from 20387 Gillick Way, so it sits outside what the 11:50 AM departure and 3:30 PM home deadline can absorb on the VTA 55 chain. The lunch tier itself runs to 4:00 PM.
